$schema_note: Every fact a clause of this register reads, with its declared kind. `read_by` IS NOT WRITTEN HERE: project-versions.mjs derives it from the evaluation trees per version and refuses a declared field no clause reads unless the field carries `$read_by_no_clause_because`, and refuses an evaluation path this file does not declare. The synthetic generator draws values from `domain.kind`, never from an outcome.
$what_a_determination_is: One payer determination on one bill line for one service under the New York workers' compensation fee schedules. The APPLIED BOUND is the scheduled amount and code the determination applied (applied_bound.*); the register never holds a scheduled amount, so the bound arrives on the determination and the register tests relations the regulation itself states (85 percent, 16 percent, the same amount, the regional fees of 329-1.3(d)(1)).

fields.note: The schedule family the service falls under. PT and OT are distinct from medical because 329-1.1 and 329-4.1(b) both claim them (NY-A1).
The date of service. The clock every date-of-service clause reads.

fields.$read_by_no_clause_because: Every date-of-service clause says `regardless of the date of accident`. The field is declared so a determination carries it and the derived read_by shows, per version, that no clause consults it.

fields.note: Which schedule the determination says it applied.

The edition identifier the determination cites. The five values are every edition date any retrieved text names, including the two the Board's revised proposal and its bracketed current text name (NY-A3).
The schedule, and for the medical schedule the section, the code was selected from. 329-1.3(c)(1) and (2) name the required source and the name changes between versions.
A code IDENTIFIER. Synthetic determinations use opaque identifiers except where the regulation itself names a code (87635, 99441, 99442, 99443).

The scheduled amount the determination applied: the amount payable for the service had it been performed directly by the billing PT, OT or physician. Licensed content; arrives on the determination, never held by the register.
The amount the determination pays.
Board-authorized, as recorded.
329-1.3(c) requires DIRECT supervision; (e) requires supervision.
PT and PTA (or OT and OTA) services on the same date of service.
Which class the determination applied to the daily RVU maximum first.
affirmed = the service is reserved to PTs/OTs by statute or regulation.
The fee schedule region the determination applied for 87635.
The RVU the determination applied to 87635.
Prior instances of 87635 on the claim.
Resident or fellow assistants billed for the procedure under determination.
Other physicians, physician assistants or nurse practitioners billed as assistants for the same procedure.
STATED LIMIT: supplied separately from the two lists above; consistency between them is not checked.
Bills submitted by the supervising physician for the patient on the date of service, this one included.

Whether the encounter qualifies as telemedicine under 12 NYCRR 325-1.8, a section outside scope. Supplied.
